lead.headline: 0.8 points separate AB81 from the champ
lead.dek: Maye I touch your TDs? is done at 122.72. AB81 has 81.98, two starters left and a live projection of 123.52. It needs 40.75 from Sam Darnold and Jaxon Smith-Njigba.
lead.pull: AB81 needs 40.75. Its last two starters project for 41.54.
body: Here is Week 8’s best game with one night to go. Maye I touch your TDs?: 122.72, final. AB81: 81.98, two starters left, live projection 123.52. That’s a gap of 0.8. The odds that read 62.7% AB81 after the late games now read 52.1%. The champ has played its whole game and gets to spend Monday watching a coin in the air.

Sunday night is what moved it. AB81’s four evening starters projected for 33.74 and delivered 27.8. Makai Lemon, the 3:06 PM pickup, did his job and then some: 11.7 on a 9.64 projection. Darius Cooper, the 3:09 PM pickup, gave back 3.9 on a 7.95. Dallas Goedert added 7.2 and the Philadelphia Eagles D/ST 5.0. That shortfall took 5.94 off the live projection, from 129.46 to 123.52. Still, the two adds combined for 15.6 from spots that had nothing in them this afternoon, and that’s the only reason this is a game.

So here is exactly what AB81 needs. The gap is 40.74, which only ties it. Win it outright and the number is 40.75 from Sam Darnold and Jaxon Smith-Njigba, projected for 16.28 and 25.26. Together that’s 41.54. They play in the same game, on the same side, at 5:15 PM Pacific on Monday. There is no third option. AB81’s whole week is one offense clearing a bar it projects to clear by less than a point.

The champ’s side of the ledger is the part that’ll sting if this goes wrong. Its flex spots went Zay Flowers 0.0 and Drake London 1.8, against projections of 18.48 and 16.46. Jacoby Brissett gave the second QB slot 4.46. Jaylen Waddle scored 14.9 on the bench. With Waddle in for Flowers, the bar on Monday would be 55.64 instead of 40.74. Harold Fannin Jr. (23.4), Drake Maye (22.46) and Bucky Irving (21.0) did enough to make it a fight. Nobody else can do anything more now.

The stakes haven’t moved. AB81 came in at 6-1 and Poochinski, the other 6-1, is losing. Win this and AB81 stands alone at 7-1. Lose it and the champ climbs to 3-5 with 77.7% playoff odds behind it and a real lifeline. My pick is AB81, because the math says so and the math is all anybody has left. The weekly edition settles it Monday night.

quick_hits.headline: Seven starters, one Monday game, one real matchup

quick_hits.body: Poochinski sits at 98.7 against the 181.84 Bad things man bad things has already posted. Caleb Williams, Luther Burden III and the Seattle Seahawks D/ST project for 35.39 combined, which lands at 134.09. Live odds: 100% Bad things man bad things. First place is about to change hands or get crowded, and Poochinski has no vote in which.

quick_hits.headline: deeboliciouskins needs 60.76 from Swift and Myers
quick_hits.body: Cherry Blossom’s 198.54 is sitting there, final. deeboliciouskins has 137.78, and D’Andre Swift and Jason Myers project for 21.75, good for 159.53. Jayden Daniels closed the night with 14.98 on an 18.41 projection. Patrick Mahomes’ 25.44 stayed on the bench, not that it would have closed this.

quick_hits.body: Stefon Diggs went last for Santa Clara’s Finest and scored 12.8, right on his 12.55 projection, a fine night that changed nothing. Joe Burrow’s 42.48 led the team and Lamar Jackson’s 0.0 undid most of it. Every starter in this game is final.

quick_hits.body: Jonah Coleman (Cherry Blossom): 20.4. Stefon Diggs (Santa Clara’s Finest): 12.8. Makai Lemon (AB81): 11.7. Hunter Henry (Santa Clara’s Finest): 6.0. Darius Cooper (AB81): 3.9.
